newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - S&P rates Fairfax notes BBB-plus/A2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - S&P rates Fairfax notes BBB-plus/A2.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it has assigned its BBB-plus rating to medium term notes and its A2 rating to promissory notes issued by John Fairfax Holdings Ltd under its A$400 million programme.
S&P said the rating outlook is stable.

"The ratings reflect the very strong franchise of the company's publishing mastheads, expected improvements in profitability and cash flow , stemming from a completion of a major press upgrade, and a measured approach to media expansion," S&P said.

"Nevertheless, Fairfax's earnings can be impacted by volatility in classified advertising revenue streams, which are linked to economic conditions in the two key markets of Sydney and Melbourne, and by fluctuations in newsprint prices," it said.

"Debt reductions and modest investments in electronic distribution of editorial and advertising material will be financed by cash flows, which will be volatile in response to economic conditions over the next one to three years."
Fairfax's shares were up three cents at A$2.73 at 12.10 (0110 GMT).
